title.zh: 英国金融监管机构就DeFi指引与加密法规启动咨询
title.en: 英国金融监管机构就DeFi指引与加密法规启动咨询

current_state.zh: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority launched consultations on guidance for DeFi firms' anti-money-laundering and financial-crime compliance and on crypto asset regulatory exemptions linked to recent legislation, ahead of a stablecoin regime taking effect in October 2027.
current_state.en: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority launched consultations on guidance for DeFi firms' anti-money-laundering and financial-crime compliance and on crypto asset regulatory exemptions linked to recent legislation, ahead of a stablecoin regime taking effect in October 2027.
